prompt:
Edit the attached approved NIGHT MARKET COURIER GAMEPLAY SCREEN into a new polished HEALTH-AND-DAMAGE combat UI concept. This is ONE actual in-game battle screen, landscape 16:9, NOT a cover, poster, comparison board, infographic or character sheet. Keep the same warm hand-painted cartoon art, slightly top-down cobblestone night-market arena with stalls and lanterns ONLY on perimeter, recognizable adult female courier with orange helmet/jacket, teal satchel, dark ponytail, and physical steamed-bun / red takeout-box / noodle-bowl monsters. Preserve generous readable open ground, human/prop artwork, no abstract geometry substitutes.
Replace the old one-hit-death presentation with clearly readable health and distinct damage feedback:
TOP HUD: compact warm brown top strip; top-left a small round courier portrait, beside it a long cream-framed CORAL RED PLAYER HEALTH BAR filled EXACTLY about 76%, a faint amber recent-damage tail from 76% to 88%, and crisp text '76 / 100' clearly centered in that bar. A small heart icon marks player health. Place '得分 004280' as a smaller separate score group just right of the health block. Center timer '02:14'. Pause button at top right. Enough spacing, no clipping or overlap, no title.
BATTLE: hero slightly right of center, full body visible and about 10% of arena height, walking forward while doing one short SIDEWAYS SLASH with a recognizable short broad parcel-opening cartoon blade: orange rubber handle, teal sheath at hip, small tape-roll handguard, silver short blade. Shoulder and wrist drive attack, feet stay in believable movement. A SMALL warm ivory slash arc in front hits TWO nearby bun monsters, neither is dead; each has a very short thin red enemy health bar above its head, about 20% remaining. Put the damage number '24' in warm ivory with dark brown outline rising just above each hit monster, different slight heights. No floating score numbers near these same monsters, no critical-hit text.
At hero's rear-left, ONE red takeout-box monster has just made contact. Put a SINGLE larger coral-red '-12' with thick cream/dark outline beside and above the HERO, clearly anchored to the hero, separated from white enemy damage numbers and from her face. A small red/orange contact spark and subtle bright outline on her jacket indicate brief hit protection; keep her fully opaque and visible, NOT blinking invisible, no blood, no defeated pose. She continues moving and striking; this is survivable damage, health 76/100. No giant shield sphere or opaque radial blast.
Other enemies: around 10-14 monsters of three types distributed across the open arena. Most untouched enemies have NO health bars. One distant noodle-bowl already injured has a thin health bar about two-thirds full. Keep enemy feet and all hazard lanes unobscured. One distant red-box dash warning is a clear orange-red narrow ground arrow, not aimed directly through HUD or hero.
Show two or three collectible physical props (small fan, green soda, bubble-wrap roll) spaced in open areas with modest glints. Remove the previous orbiting skateboards/ring from the hero so new hit feedback is clear.
BOTTOM UI: translucent floating joystick bottom-left. Bottom-right small warm receipt-style READ-ONLY weapon panel with short-blade icon and Chinese label '拆箱快刀', tiny understated cooldown tick; a nearby small bubble-wrap status badge with '1次' OPTIONAL only if it does not falsely imply the just-taken damage was blocked—prefer omit shield status in this scene. No attack button, no skill tree, no hearts lives counter, no upgrade menu.
Design priorities: player HP must be unmistakable; white 24 enemy damage and red -12 player damage readable by position and sign as well as color; NO full-screen wall of numbers; no blood, gore, extra overlays or explanatory callouts. Keep sophisticated clean game UI and the approved charming delivery-girl art style. Chinese text limited to exact short labels above. This is a design mockup showing one combat moment, not a final asset sheet.
